status: Prospective exploratory sequence-grouped comparison; launch only after full-video engineering verification
method: regional_memory_prompts_gate_v1 unchanged; every original SAM2 parameter frozen; native frame selection and dense memory retained
initialization: Fresh author TokenLearners per fold and arm, same seed and exact initial tensor digest; never use diagnostic weights.
sampling: One 8-frame author-sampled clip per training sequence per epoch. Sequence order follows numerically sorted full cohort excluding validation. Seed = base + fold*100000 + epoch*14 + training_index. Identical clips for both arms.
training_history: Verified original full-video native teacher prefix, strictly before the first target; differentiable own predicted writes inside each seven-target block. Original full-video timing. This is truncated teacher-prefix training, not full-video on-policy training.
loss: Unchanged pinned SAM2 multi-mask focal20/Dice1/IoU1/objectness1 through decoder_clip_loss. Raw pre-presence masks; native inference handling unchanged.
selection: Final epoch only. Write final weights and training receipt before evaluating full original validation videos. Do not choose a checkpoint from validation.
evaluation: Native prompt only, autonomous predicted memory, no teacher bank during validation. Compatible official native references. Save every target, hashes, original token/pointer counts and separate auxiliary counts. Reproduce fresh native output on the complete engineering subset first.
primary: Equal-sequence mean present-frame Dice. Paired sequence bootstrap 95% interval and Wilcoxon with Holm correction for regional-native and regional-global.
secondary: IoU, Boundary F, empty-frame false alarms with denominator, re-detection and wall time. Runtime includes method overhead; no compute-budget parity claim because auxiliary tokens are added.
meaningful_screen: Regional-native mean >=0.01; regional-global mean >0; at least14/21 native wins; positive 95% interval lower bounds and Holm p<0.05 for both contrasts; no extra pooled empty-frame false alarms. This is a reporting screen, not an inference threshold or a checkpoint-selection rule.
execution: Run folds sequentially. Each fold completes both arms before interpretation. Stop on source/asset mismatch, replay or integrity failure, nonfinite results, wrong native/auxiliary token schedules or original-weight mutation. Unexpected accuracy is recorded without changing settings.
limits: PolypGen has already informed the research and is not untouched confirmation. Sequence grouping does not establish patient independence. Unseen external data and real multi-object integration verification are required for broader claims. Do not resume stopped decoder adaptation.
